message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Li Moumou (mother?) knows her son Li Moumou Jia is a criminal, captured, she gives him 400 yuan to escape, then shelters him at home, provides food, etc. Also provides false name for medical treatment to avoid police. This is classic "窝藏罪" i.e., harboring a criminal (concealing a criminal). In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "窝藏罪" (concealing a criminal). Possibly also "帮助犯罪分子逃跑" (helping a criminal escape) which is also part of the same offense. The indictment says "应当以窝藏罪追究其刑事责任". So answer: [罪名]窝藏罪<eoa>. No other crimes. So final answer.
